sections.title: 1. Introduction and Purpose
sections.body: The Information Security Management System (ISMS) of TEST is established to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets supporting the IT operations.

bullets: Local Virtual Environment: Including the primary server room housing the Windows-based server cluster.

sections.title: 4. Technical and Logical Boundaries
sections.body: This ISMS encompasses the Windows-based enterprise ecosystem, specifically:
bullets: Identity Management: All user accounts, groups, and permissions managed via Windows Server AD.
Server Infrastructure: All Windows Server instances (including VMware) hosted on VMware.
Endpoint Management: All enterprise-managed Windows workstations and laptops managed via Group Policy.

sections.title: 5. Exclusions and Justifications
sections.body: The following areas are excluded from the scope of the ISMS:
bullets: Other servers except DC, and one workstation
